name: Original agency source parser preserves Markdown body bytes
asks: Construct the smallest source-owned parser repair that preserves the exact authored Markdown body at the existing shared agency source boundary, as a prerequisite of the full agency normalization obligation.

met-when.says: The existing shared src/agency-source-declaration.mjs source declaration boundary and its existing actual callers receive the construction; no parallel parser, per-section converter, compatibility branch or new runtime identity is introduced.

The declaration is derived only from complete source bytes received with their matching SHA-256; valid UTF-8 must round trip exactly, and supplied authored mappings or offsets may corroborate but never replace source bytes.

Use the original Markdown-owned split-markdown-frontmatter-fence and original YAML codec at independently received source revisions to derive frontmatter and the exact body; a complete closing fence terminator leaves every subsequent byte in body, including leading blank lines, indentation, trailing whitespace, LF, CRLF and Unicode.

Differentiate absent frontmatter from an opened but malformed or unclosed fence; refuse malformed or ambiguous YAML, duplicate keys, conflicting body fields, invalid UTF-8, mismatched source hash and conflicting authored corroboration without source effects.

Preserve the exact original JSON declaration and its authored method; preserve source metadata, order and the original source-qualified identity for valid Markdown declarations, without inventing authority or changing Character trait semantics.

Independently receive the exact 54 currently witnessed source files against physical body bytes after the closing fence, with source hashes checked; also receive absent and malformed fences, EOF, LF, CRLF, indentation, trailing whitespace, Unicode and hash/corroboration refusal.

Receive the original source declaration consumer interfaces and their actual record and Character planning callers against the selected source revision; this parser slice creates no migration authority and no input is retired or rewritten until the separate complete family planning, link-preservation, collision, exclusion and original apply obligations hold.

Preserve every condition of the parent agency-normalization-retains-methods-and-role-traits Requirement, including typed persona and mask traits, prior-normalization repair, whole-plan safety, link/resource preservation and actual installed consumer receiving; this bounded parser construction is not completion of that requirement.

Generate specification, architecture, design and target source through the original zero-cash house producers and independent receiving; preserve provenance and unreceived Proof, and do not hand-edit executable source or generated Data.

x-provenance.basis: Derived bounded construction slice of the existing agency-normalization-retains-methods-and-role-traits Requirement and its v4 Architecture and high-level design, answering the Leader direction to finish the shared agency family.
x-provenance.status: Bounded requirement proposal; no admission, fabrication, migration or parent completion asserted.
